text: Rural access exception: for HMO-RURAL members, the physical therapy requirement in criterion C-02 is reduced from 6 weeks to 4 weeks because of limited therapy access. Effective 2026-04-01 through 2026-12-31.
Temporary PPO-GOLD exception: conservative treatment requirement reduced to 2 weeks during the 2025 therapy-provider shortage. Effective 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31. Expired.
